product.title: Private Driving Tour of Amish Country from Philadelphia

description.text: Discover Lancaster County on a private driving tour from Philadelphia with a dedicated guide and vehicle for your party alone. The route covers Amish Country back roads, a covered bridge, and Lancaster County farmland with flexible pacing at farms and scenic viewpoints. Your guide shares Plain community history and rural Pennsylvania stories without the schedule of a large group bus. This premium private format suits families who want an unhurried Amish Country day tailored to their interests.

highlights: Private Amish Country driving tour from Philadelphia
